_comment: Defaults the workbench can override in user://setup.json. config_version 2 is the shipped schema. A saved file with a lower version is upgraded before the codex refresh redraws: a v1 spawns cell list without spawn_rects is grouped into 3x1 border gates. difficulty presets scale spawned wave counts, enemy hp/speed, and kill gold. settlement is the wave-clear vacancy roll. combat is target-lock and path refresh. economy.start_* and wave_clear_* are the match defaults. The map is 20x20, tile 128, origin at the north-west cell, +x east, +y south. spawn_rects are enemy gates. Each rect is {edge, middle, length, width}. edge is north|south|west|east (the outermost row or column). middle is [x, y] of the center cell, which is the cell the user clicked. length is 3 and width is 1. North and south gates run along x and stay on that border row: the width axis points inward and does not step off the border. West and east gates run along y the same way. Corner cells (0,0), (19,0), (0,19) and (19,19) are never a middle. spawns is the derived unique birth-cell list, rebuilt from spawn_rects on load. starter_buildings are {kind, cell} using Building.kind names. starter_units are opening stand positions {unit, cell, sex}. starter_props are extra interior trees and rocks {kind: tree|rock, cell}. The border forest and the four fixed rocks stay generated by the match.
